text:
sara: Quick sync  PR #4987 adds a localized region availability table and copyable request samples. Need legal + i18n sign-off before merge.

lee: link please :eyes: 

sara: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987/files  file is docs/region/availability.md (table + samples)

pranav: legal note: do NOT imply residency. Use exact phrasing: "Routing to a region endpoint does not guarantee data residency. If you require residency, contact sales for a dedicated residency contract." Also add a short GDPR callout for EU customers.

maya: i18n note: header names (e.g. X-Redwood-Region) and SDK enum labels must not be localized. We'll add a translator comment. Recommend ISO 3166 alpha-2 for country examples and BCP47 for locale tags.

sara: added the legal sentence and a GDPR footnote. Inserted translator comments at top of the page.

lee: small question on examples: curl uses region value "eu1". That might confuse users since infra uses "eu-west-1". Can we pick a canonical routing example and a separate locale example (en-GB)?

pranav: agree. For routing header use region identifiers like "eu-west-1"; for language/locale examples use "en-GB". Keeps routing vs locale semantics clear.

sara: updated both samples and labeled the simple curl as "copyable". Added a minimal Python snippet too: 
```python
import os, requests
resp = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')}", "X-Redwood-Region": "eu-west-1"},
  json={"model":"rwd-1", "input":"hello"}
)
print(resp.json())
```

maya: translators: add a crowdin note: "DO NOT TRANSLATE: X-Redwood-Region, X-Redwood-Locale, region enum labels". I'll run a quick sweep to ensure those tokens are preserved.

deploy-bot: Preview built for PR #4987: https://preview.docs.redwood/4987 

lee: one last ask  call out SDK minimum version (>= 1.4.0) required for the region enum. Also add a footnote link to residency policy: https://redwood.company/legal/residency

sara: noted & pushed. CI running. Leaving merge to lee after i18n sweep and green CI. :white_check_mark:
